1. **When did the yellowing of your skin or eyes (jaundice) first appear, and has it been getting worse gradually?**  
2. **Are you noticing any other symptoms such as itching (especially on your hands or feet), abdominal pain or swelling, nausea/vomiting, fever, or any recent weight loss?**

message.content: The yellowing of my skin and eyes started four days ago, and it has been getting progressively worse since then. I haven't had any fever, abdominal pain, or vomiting. I also haven't noticed any itching, swelling, or recent weight loss. I've just been feeling very tired and lightheaded, and I've noticed my stools are dark.
